name: Saba
format: signed int16 little endian; metres = value / 4; rows north to south
terrainCredit: Beeldmateriaal Nederland / Saba 2023 bare-earth LiDAR DTM, CC BY 4.0; reprojected and downsampled.
worldCredit: Made with Natural Earth. Public domain.
visualCleanup: No isolated-needle cleanup applied to local DTM. Modern road grading and other terrain alterations may remain.
limitations: 16 m elevation-derived coast and visual CRS/datum alignment; authored vegetation and historical cleanup; approximate de-lighting; underwater skirt is not surveyed bathymetry.
projection: local equirectangular, metres; X east, Z south

imagery.processing: Co-registered to DEM; 0.2-pixel antialias only across natural ground. Median cleanup limited to compact neutral-bright components of <=20 pixels, <=6 pixels wide/high, in predominantly vegetated context; broad pale rock/cliffs and canopy detail retained, no global bright-ground recolouring. Bounded local shadow lifting. RGB is an approximate appearance seed, not calibrated reflectance. Modern features may remain.

vegetation.format: uint8 vegetation probability, rows north to south
vegetation.provenance: Authored RGB greenness interpretation, constrained by elevation and slope; not a surveyed forest/species map.
vegetation.variantLibrary: Native seeded recursive branches, foliage clusters and projected-error LOD; no Three.js runtime.

playableScope: Single continuous island region; no whole-world generation or voyage compression.

terrainSurvey.sourceVerticalDatum: Publisher local DTM heights; not transformed to a hydrographic/chart datum.
terrainSurvey.processing: 16 m area-average excluding missing ground returns; close <=128 m return gaps and interpolate nearby measured ground; bilinear reprojection to local equirectangular grid; quarter-metre quantization. Measured land elevations > 0.1 m retained; remaining cells use the separately declared authored coastal depth model.

authoredBathymetry.provenance: Gameplay coastal skirt from shore distance; not measured bathymetry, chart soundings or a navigational aid.
authoredBathymetry.method: Euclidean distance from each wet cell centre to the nearest dry cell, minus half the 16 m grid spacing; depth = min(120, 2 + 0.15 * distanceMetres).
